consequence: CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) and CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) are disconnected in the BPMN process. If routing expressions rely on header 'OrderCodeValid' or 'OrganizationId', the flow fails or defaults unconditionally to EscalationEnd.
mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_003 asserts that undefined routes divert cleanly to EscalationEnd_11. Integration model must be refactored to place CallActivity_77 sequentially after CallActivity_4 before ExclusiveGateway_80.

risk: Input Payload Memory Bloat via Expression Property
consequence: CallActivity_4 reads full '${in.body}' into property 'InputPayload'. For inbound SOAP messages nearing the configured maximumBodySize (40MB), storing duplicate payloads in memory will exhaust JVM heap space and cause OutOfMemory errors.
mitigation: TC_GLOVIA_004 verifies payload preservation, and sizing bounds should be enforced by asserting on max attachment and body parameters (<maximumBodySize>40</maximumBodySize>).

risk: Escalation End vs One-Way Message Exchange Pattern
consequence: MessageFlow_114 specifies messageExchangePattern 'OneWay'. When EndEvent_11 raises an escalation event with returnExceptionToSender=false, the sender might receive HTTP 202 Accepted while downstream processing halted, losing transactional visibility.
mitigation: Unit tests TC_GLOVIA_003 and TC_GLOVIA_004 validate SOAP Fault propagation and custom headers (e.g. Country, Region, BusinessObject) to ensure error states are recorded in the MPL and communicated.

risk: Groovy 4 XmlSlurper Compatibility in Script Assets
consequence: GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy requires explicit import 'groovy.xml.XmlSlurper'. In environments upgrading to Groovy 4/SAP Cloud Integration newer kernels, missing explicit imports or local name navigation will cause runtime CompilationCustomizerException.
mitigation: Tests mock execution results and script unit verification is executed via CI harness confirming correct XML tree parsing by local name without prefix dependency.
